newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva Oct airport air cargo traffic down 9.8pct.
newsitem.headline: Geneva Oct airport air cargo traffic down 9.8pct.

text.p: Geneva's Cointrin airport handled 5,563 tonnes of air cargo traffic in October 1996, a decrease of 9.8 percent on the same month in 1995, airport authority figures show.
January-October 1996 air cargo at Geneva totalled 53,364 tonnes, down 7.1 percent on 1995 levels.

With the start of its winter timetable on Oct 27, Swissair started a twice-weekly full-freighter service between Geneva and Singapore using a 67-tonne capacity McDonnell Douglas DC10-30F and made Geneva the hub for its weekly Sao Paulo service.

Postal traffic handled at the airport increased by 3.9 percent on the same month in 1995 to 798 tonnes while January-October volume fell by 1.7 percent on the first ten months of the previous year to 7,224 tonnes.
